universe.note: the exact 165 coins of the LONGSCOUT WIDE165 runs; BTC and the original nine are never traded; no coin is added or dropped by hand

forward_fetch.boundary: B = the latest 00:00 UTC at or before the fetch time; only 1h bars with open time < B and close time < B are kept (closed bars only)
forward_fetch.overlap: bars present in both base and forward fetch (2026-10-01 00:00 .. base last bar) must be equal in o,h,l,c,v,qv, else the row is INCOMPLETE
forward_fetch.runs_on: owner Windows PC only (the cloud gets HTTP 403 from Binance)

merge_rules.btc: BTC must have every 1h bar from its base start to B-1h, else the row is INCOMPLETE
merge_rules.coin_gap: a coin whose forward data has a missing 1h bar, or ends before B-1h, makes the row INCOMPLETE and is named. The row still reports what the leads do on the data up to the coin's last contiguous bar (labelled INCOMPLETE, never COMPLETE). A permanent delisting needs a disclosed amendment; it is never handled silently.
merge_rules.extra: a coin listed by the forward fetch but absent from the universe is ignored

rule.name: Codex rule v1 accounting, unchanged code path (sieve_v1_panel.worker via longscout_run.worker)
rule.costs: pnl at 7 bp (engine fees+slip), 15 bp (primary), 23 bp (stress); funding 0.5 bp per 4h bar charged by the backtest
rule.liquidity: D01 point-in-time rule (prior 30 complete days median quote volume >= $10m, >= 720 consecutive 1h bars)
rule.primary_book: order 0 (alphabetical coin priority), path intrabar scenario
rule.diagnostics: 40 coin orders (seed 20261112) median, and the worst-case intrabar scenario of order 0
rule.only_change: backtest.run is called with t0 = t_fwd instead of 2022-08-26 06:00; nothing else in the rule, sizing, cost or signal code changes

rows.immutable: a row is never rewritten; a second run at the same B is refused
rows.replay: each row is a pure re-run from t_fwd over closed bars < B; the latest earlier COMPLETE row must be reproduced exactly (every earlier closed trade and every earlier signal still present and identical), else NONPARITY
rows.statuses: COMPLETE | INCOMPLETE (data/coverage problem, named) | NONPARITY (replay differs from an earlier row, named)

review.primary: per lead, order-0 forward closes at 15 bp
review.decision_at: 30 forward closes per lead: meanR15 > 0 and meanR23 >= 0 -> FORWARD_CONSISTENT (still research; PAPER needs Codex + moe); else FORWARD_KILLED
review.interim_flag: at 10 or more closes, meanR15 <= -0.30 is flagged EARLY_WARNING (report only, not a decision)
review.pooled: the six books pooled (count, sum R15) is a separately labelled DIAGNOSTIC in every row, never a pass or a decision
review.cadence_warning: screen cadence is roughly 0.3-1.5 order-0 closes per week per lead (about 4 per week for all six), so 30 closes per lead takes about 5 months (l24) to over a year (s36). This is slow by design; it is the honest speed of max-one-position 4h rules.

never: no account, key, order, PAPER, runtime, scheduler or installer action from this code
no change to any lead rule, parameter, coin list or t_fwd after this freeze; a changed rule is a new candidate with a new freeze
no past row is edited; corrections are new amendment files
account 1 and the account-4 R6 canary are never touched
clock: unchanged backtest clock: a lead's daily condition is judged on COMPLETED UTC days; the signal sits on the 00:00 UTC 4h candle of the next day (02:00 Cairo in winter) and the modeled entry is the NEXT bar open, 04:00 UTC (06:00 Cairo), after that candle closes. It is never moved to a 00:00 UTC fill. Rows record decision_bar_open_utc for signals and t_in (fill bar open, UTC) for trades. The daily-loss halt uses Africa/Cairo calendar days, as in the backtest. A signal on the t_fwd candle itself (2026-11-16 00:00 UTC) is post-freeze and counts.
costs_proxy: 15 bp primary / 7 bp / 23 bp stress on turnover, plus the backtest's adverse funding proxy (0.5 bp per 4h bar against the position); no historical or live funding prices are used; the STOPPED funding-mark audit is not resumed by this book
